summary_text: In February 2026, the user purchased fresh, unbranded vegetables on eight independent dates. The basket consistently included core cooking staples, specifically Onion, Baby Potato, and Coriander Leaves, which appeared across multiple orders. Local Tomato and Red Carrot also appeared on multiple dates. The majority of purchases occurred on weekdays during the afternoon, with one morning purchase observed. As all items are unbranded and fresh, specific brand loyalty cannot be established, but the recurrence of specific produce types indicates a stable preference for these ingredients.
